scope: Actual Linux FUSE; synthetic local iteration workloads, not Bazel/RBE latency
source_boundary: Stage C before D/E. Final 64-operation churn includes explicit owner unlock. Longer churn precedes journal seek-only fix; journal run includes seek fix but precedes teardown-only owner unlock.

limits.oversized_exception: One oversized payload deleted synchronously alone after draining; bytes remain accounted

retained_regression.cause: Trimming iterator repeatedly crossed growing retired-key/tombstone prefix; fix seeks from previous durable floor plus one
retained_regression.validation: Extended 12288-generation retention test and strict matched rerun; no durability or retention limits relaxed

qualifications: Three rotated trials; fresh private mounts/overlays; no Cargo/heavy build overlap in accepted timed cells.
Churn has fixed 250ms settle; physical backing-file count/bytes measured while mounted before linked survivor and shutdown.
Journal query times include fresh CLI process startup. Expired token returns full invalidation, not equivalent incremental response.
Logical history bound is not a physical WAL/LSM or RSS bound. At 12000 mutations candidate uses more RSS and allocated disk; every mutation adds durable retention bookkeeping and trimming tombstones.
Foreground payload_directory_syncs excludes retirement-worker syncs; logical payload traffic excludes redo scratch.
Earlier regression and raw artifacts retained locally; these component results do not establish end-to-end Bazel improvement.

validation.initial_default_parallel_failure: 4 immediate-reopen owner-lock failures; fixed by explicit lock release after shutdown, full 39-case rerun passed
